restock.scale_source: review/W-20261105-0953-AX패치3.3/scale-analysis.md (11/05 11:1x ledger): G05277ffe and Gb5d0dde7 are 60만+ goods 12-14 shops sell 39-49/h with 3.4-4.0% mature break (ledger guard rate 4.8-6.7%) and a 0.35-0.42 h median hold; one unit each, after the proven SKUs and food. G8ec51935 (worst cost 1.74M) waits for a larger cap: under 4M one held sofa cut G1515d951 refills 4 -> 2 (independent review replay). Food cap 45만->65만: food sells in 0.1 h, 0 spoiled, and its cap cut 416 of the last 2,000 guard lines; it is filled before the 60만+ lines. With the 15M cap (hard_limits): G05277ffe, Gb5d0dde7 and G8ec51935 at 2 units each, G03d0199f (13 shops, 33/h, 7.8% break, 0.87 h) and G00327e80 (13 shops, 21/h, 2.8%, 1.10 h) at 1, about 11.3M at worst cost with the proven SKUs and food, the rest for the formula. Scale 2 (a person's 15M hard_limits cap, 11/05 11:48): 60만+ goods to 3 units each (G03d0199f, G00327e80 2), high_price_max_units 2->3 and cover_hours 3->6 so the demand model asks for them (our share 0.35-0.76/h each, 11:50 model); at worst cost the targets come to ~19M, so the 15M cap binds and held cost (0.6 x list) sits near 12-15M (replay review/W-20261105-0953-AX패치3.3/scale2-result.md) Scale 3 (12:24-13:05 ledger and kit log, 15M cap): G8ec51935 sold 2 in 40 min (1,821,164 and 2,182,448 on 1.66M cost) and was refilled each window -> 4; Gb5d0dde7 held 3 units bought 12:27 unsold across the 12:41 and 13:01 windows (strategy rule: same extra units across two windows) -> 2. The 150M hard_limits bound is for the meta-harness to grow into (meta/terra.md three tests). Scale 4 (11/06 15:10, a person's call inside the 150M bound): 15M -> 30M. book and revenue percentiles sat at 0.755-0.759 / 0.722-0.741 for 25 h while the stock-cost guard still cut lines each window (966 of the last 3,000 guard cuts, 15:05 window included) with 10.8M held, 99.6M cash and the top ten holding 72M-525M (review/W-20261106-1457-AX순위정체/analysis.md). Scale 5 (11/06 15:30): in the 14:44 and 15:03 supply windows every cut on a priority / proven line was 'units per SKU' (41 and 56 lines), none 'stock cost' (those were on unlisted formula lines), so the cap was never what held the 60만+ lines; each listed SKU sold what it bought in 24 h with no break (G03d0199f 10 sales, net 315,578 each; G00327e80 10, 532,264; G6b9db161 19, 85,632; G75f11c19 49, 28,629) and sat at its target, so the cuts to 1 (Terra 11/05 18:36, 11/06 03:17; Astra 11/05 09:49) go back to 2 (review/W-20261106-1525-AX상한바이어/sku_sales.md). Scale 6 (11/06 17:2x, W-20261106-1650-AX1등작전, review/W-20261106-1650-AX1등작전/analysis.md): revenue, not demand, is held by our supply. Over the last 24 h our 30만+ goods units sold 170 of 173 (98%, median hold 0.99 h, net margin 0.213 of list) while the revenue top five bought 549-2,610 such units each (moss-and-oak 1,826: 98% sold, hold 0.51 h); 30만+ goods are 91% of the market's 770M/h. The 17 SKUs listed first are the 60만+ goods with the most expected net flow over the last 24 h (n/h x ((1 - break) x sale - cost) from ledger supply and settle rows, break 6-10%, net 4.4만-30만 a unit), so the listed-only rule stays and its list grows; max_stock_cost 30M -> 120M (bound 150M) (keep_cash stays 4.5M: 10M would leave a shop reset to 5M by a bankruptcy buying nothing, test_caution), high_price_max_units 4 -> 10. Scale 7 (11/06 19:1x, W-20261106-1900-AX자본투입): the cap never bound (no 'stock cost' cut on a listed line since 16:00; stock 53.1M, cash 64.3M); the demand model's rate x my_share x cover asked 1-5 units of goods the market sells 25-56/h, because our share was low where our first asks (1.05 x the whole-round median, 0.77-0.82 of list) lost to the last 2 h's 0.65-0.73 (10 of 52 30만+ quotes won 18:22-19:02). fill_listed asks each listed SKU up to its target; targets = max(old, ceil(market sold/h over 6 h x 0.10 x 2 h)) (2-12); 7 SKUs added (break 0-11%, 6-13 shops); unit caps 10 -> 20 (bounds 20/100). Expected cost of all targets ~105M (worst 133M) under the 120M cap. max_stock_cost 120M -> 150M (the hard_limits top): with book 115M the cash binds first; at a 0.25/h revenue turnover and 6.7% margin the book passes 160M in about 22 h, and the cap should not be what stops it then. Scale 8 (11/06 21:0x, a person 19:03: hard_limits open but no bankruptcy): max_stock_cost 150M -> 1B; what limits a buy now is hard_limits.cash_buffer (500k + 13% worst refunds still owed on 6 h of our warranted goods sales + a day of storage + the worst day's 2.5M book loss). Scale 9 (11/07 00:3x, W-20261106-2225-AX극단상향, main 23:25 '판매 대금이 바로 재고로 굴러가게'): after the cash buffer fell to 7.7M, 8-13% of book sat as cash over it (22:40-00:10) while the 00:01 window cut lines on units per SKU, the 650k food cap (125 of the last 300 guard cuts) and the listed-only rule, not on cash. Dear goods are not short of stock (since 17:18 at most 1 'not in stock' per dear SKU) but of quote requests, so the cash goes to breadth: 10 30만+ SKUs the market settled most by value over 6 h that we did not list (6-14 shops, break 3.4-10.6%, expected net 0.07-0.16 of list over the grade mix), 2-6 units each (~17M expected, ~23M worst); food (257 sold in 6 h, 0 expired, 25% gross, 76 'not in stock' on Gb2392fa9/Gef4d3036/G200e39a3) cap 650k -> 3M and 4 -> 10 units a line; G75f11c19 (23 sold / 6 h, held 0) 3 -> 8, G9c9f8f94 2 -> 4, G754bf0ca 5 -> 8, G8095ddd6 6 -> 8 (sold 2-4x their target in 6 h). The 10 go before the food lines (independent review: last in the list, 8 lines a run, they would seldom be reached).

price.breakeven_source: A person 11/06 22:22 ("최대한 점수를 올려", no bankruptcy, no sale under cost + expected warranty): floors at break-even. 11/06 20:30-22:30 76 of 96 lost 100만+ quotes opened at a floor over the SKU median (cost 0.684 of list, median 0.694; 85 of 96 buyers never offered), and over 17:18-22:30 30만+ quotes paid 42% at the median, 13% over 1.10 x. min_profit 1000/3% of list -> 1/0; goods_break 0.08 -> 0.035 (grade A's market 3.0% + 0.5 pt; B 12.2% and C 34.4% and any higher measured SKU x grade rate still win; our refunds were 5.6% of warranted goods sales, 33.1M/588.8M, over a mix of grades); median_up 1.05 -> 1.0 and 30만+ goods 1.0 -> 0.97 x the 3 h median. Book is 0.5 and revenue 0.3 of shop ALL: at 11/06 22:24 a book rank was ~31M and a revenue rank ~23-120M, so 1M of book ~ 2.7M of revenue; a break-even sale adds revenue at no book cost (review/W-20261106-2225-AX극단상향). 22:37-23:05 (after 5a1aaed): at 0.97 x median 34 of 44 30만+ quotes were agreed but 19 went unpaid: buyers that accept several shops pay the cheapest (G8ec51935: ours 1,580,386 = 0.97 x, paid elsewhere at 1,557,000 = 0.955 x), 0.94 x (23:11-23:41) paid 9 of 34 such quotes against 16 of 49 at 0.97 x, so it went back to 0.97 x; the medians are now per SKU x grade (market_model grade_ratio): B and C units were opened at the all-grade median.
